flight_gate.position_method: Euclidean3D error: latest received MAVLink position versus RPC Cosys truth in mission NEU metres. Receipt age, RPC brackets and raw poses retained. All armed IN_AIR/TAKEOFF/LANDING samples included. Hover speed<0.5m/s and absolute climb<0.3m/s; cruise horizontal speed>=1m/s; remaining samples transition.

controller_tracking.hover_target: Each captured native localNedOriginUeCm /100, plus first take_off commandedheight in up; initial_hover phase only.
controller_tracking.cruise_target: Requested routeN/E in missionframe, before MAVLink integer-coordinate rounding. Active mission_current1 uses ready MAVLink home-to-waypoint1; n>1 uses waypoint(n-1)-to-n. Perpendicular cross-track is to infinite leg line; finite-segment distance also counts overshoot. Vertical target is ready MAVLink homeMSL minus geodesy.ORIGIN.altitudeMSL plus requested relativeheight. Only AUTO cruise samples from firstsortie auto/resumed_auto phases.

flight_gate.startup_sensor_health_note: GPS health initially false while disarmed; bounded prearm wait passed before first takeoff. Every flight pose has healthy GPS and no GPS-glitch flag.
